hero.subtitle: Skin Studio
hero.headline: Your skin, well understood.
hero.script: Solid science and elevated sensoriality for skin, hair, and body.
hero.body: We believe in care where efficacy, evidence, and judgment coexist with a conscious selection of what we use on our skin and body.

featured.heading: Facials
featured.description: Personalized 30- and 60-minute facials, designed around what your skin needs today.

pillars.title: Judgment
pillars.description: The best of science and nature, chosen with evidence and without compromising efficacy.

pillars.title: Serenity
pillars.description: An in-cabin experience built around you: silence or conversation, aromatherapy, your music.

pillars.title: Personalization
pillars.description: Your skin has a memory, and so do we. We track your skin type, sensitivity, and past treatments, so every visit picks up exactly where the last one left off.

treatments.heading: Facials
treatments.note: Booked by duration, Targeted or Signature. Your protocol is assigned after an in-person skin assessment and your goals.

items.name: Targeted
items.description: A facial personalized to your skin on the day of your visit. After an in-cabin evaluation, your esthetician selects the ideal ampoule for you.

items.name: Purify
items.description: Decongests, deep-cleanses, and clears pores with careful extractions.

items.name: Lift
items.description: A facial sculpting ritual that combines technology and massage to tone, define, and support a firmer appearance.

items.name: Longevity
items.description: An intensive treatment featuring BABOR, focused on visible signs of aging, luminosity, and vitality — also ideal as pre-event prep.

items.name: Microbiomic
items.description: Designed with BABOR for sensitive, reactive, or stressed skin. Helps strengthen the skin barrier and restore comfort, hydration, and balance.

items.name: Collagen Botox
items.description: A firming, volumizing treatment that helps soften expression lines and restore visible density to the skin.

items.name: Vegan Glow
items.description: A 100% vegan facial that brightens and hydrates the skin with botanical ingredients, leaving a fresh, natural glow.

stripe.quote: Make space to take good care of yourself.

circle.corner1: Wellness is more than a trend. It's a lifestyle that embraces self care, balance, and whole health.
circle.corner2: Less noise, better choices, and care designed to last.
circle.ring: Gentle science, personal care, and results you can feel from the first session, so your skin reflects real wellness ·

booking.heading: Book in seconds. We remember your skin.
booking.body: Skin type, sensitivities, preferences, and history, ready before you arrive.

quotes: Experience the perfect blend of science and relaxation, and let your skin reflect the healthiest version of you.
Every day is a new beginning. Take a deep breath, smile, and start again.
Gentle, healthy skincare. Taking care of your skin doesn't have to be complicated or invasive.
